Case reference: 2013000070.CaseDesc: On June 4, 1980, Serge Jobin was seen for the last time in the De Lorimier district of Montreal, Quebec. Serge may have taken a bus to New York City in the United States and is hearing impaired and mute.

By August 28 he had not returned and the police were notified. His boat was recovered by police but his remains were never found. Murdo is presumed to have drowned.

His appendix was present. He is thought to have been in the water for a few days to several days.

Case reference: 2014011272.CaseDesc: During the morning of June 10, 2014, Yvonne Wallace left her residence in Niagara Falls, Ontario. She has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2018059603.CaseDesc: Following new information, investigators believe Lisa MacEachern was last seen in downtown Calgary, Alberta, leaving a business in the 800 block of First Street S.W. on Wednesday, June 27, 2018. Lisa is also believed to have been staying at a residence in the 1000 block of First Street S.W. prior to her disappearance. There are no traces of Lisa's life after her last known phone contact with her family, which occurred on Tuesday, July 3, 2018. She has not been heard from since. It is uncharacteristic for Lisa's family to have no contact with her and they remain concerned for her welfare.

Case reference: 2012020079.CaseDesc: On September 26, 1991, Lavina Tocher was last seen in Parkman, Saskatchewan. On the 12th of December of that year, she was reported missing. Investigation and searches have failed to locate her.

Case reference: 2014006416.CaseDesc: On January 24, 2014, at approximately 10:15 a.m., Richard Hicks was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2024055167.CaseDesc: Rodina Bottle is believed to have last been seen by family sometime in 2014 in Lac Seul First Nation, Ontario.  The family believes she might have moved to Thunder Bay, Fort Frances or the Toronto area.

Case reference: 2021050906.CaseDesc: On September 19, 2012, at approximately 8:30 p.m., Gregory Mish was last seen near the American Falls, in the area of Prospect Point, Niagara Falls, New York. During the time of his disappearance, Gregory was despondent.

Scar: Head, 2 x 3 x 2-inch scar in the shape of a Z above the left side of his ear

Case reference: 2012020040.CaseDesc: Jerry Paquette was last seen on the Louis Bull First Nations Reserve on January 1, 1982.

Case reference: 2008016999.CaseDesc: Meryl Newcombe and George Weeden were last seen and reported missing to the White River OPP on October 29, 1959.  The two men had been at a lodge operated by Meryl at Mile 107 of the CPR line, west of Chapleau, Ontario. Meryl and George had planned a hunting trip and both were last seen between mile marker 106 and 107 of the CPR line southeast of White River and west of Chapleau. A large- scale search was conducted at the time, and again the following Spring (1960). The search failed to locate them, and to this day, they have not been located. George’s exact date of birth is not known, but the year of birth is understood to be 1896 or 1897.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Leg, injured in a train wreck in 1941

Case reference: 2005005699.CaseDesc: On June 22, 1991, the body of an unidentified man was recovered from the Niagara River between Horseshoe Falls and the "Maid of the Mist" boat docks. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 113 lbs, however this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. He had signs of having suffered an acute or chronic right lung infection. He is estimated to have been dead for several months. Biogeographic Ancestry testing predicts this unidentified male is either of European ancestry, or South Asian ancestry, or mixed European and South Asian ancestry.

Teeth: Several amalgam fillings in his teeth and multiple posterior teeth in his upper and lower jaw were lost/removed prior to death.

Case reference: 2013000012.CaseDesc: Cameron March was last seen by his mother on May 7, 1975, at approximately 3:15 p.m. He was playing on a swing set in a next door neighbour's yard located on Blind Line in the City of Burlington, Ontario. Cameron followed the adult neighbour into the residence and asked to play with a friend. When told the friend was sleeping, Cameron left the residence, walking towards his house.

Teeth: Braces, Braces on lower left side of teeth.  One top tooth discolored.
Shirt: White, T-shirt with green band around collar. Brown and green monkeys climbing on front.

Jacket: Grey, Bomber, dark grey corduroy front

Case reference: 2014005240.CaseDesc: Morden Utinowatum was last seen on April 6, 2002 at 9:00pm in the area of Beaver Ranch, Alberta, near Fort Vermilion. Morden  wandered off from a residence after visiting family in the area.  Morden has not been seen or heard from since. Morden suffered from alcohol addiction problems.

Case reference: 2013000088.CaseDesc: On February 19, 1973, Pierre Gariepy was seen for the last time in the Plateau-Mont-Royal district of Montreal, Quebec. Pierre is manic-depressive and was frequently hospitalized.

Case reference: 2006016699.CaseDesc: Michael Gadke and Morris Werenko were last seen in the vicinity of Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario, and were last heard from as they were circling over Goulais Bay in a Cessna C-172 aircraft. Case reference: 2014006219.CaseDesc: On the night of the 17 to 18 August 2013, Benoit Germain was seen for the last time while he was attending a truck show in Baie-du-Febvre, Quebec. His car was found abandoned a few days later on a trail to a wooded area north of La Tuque, Quebec. Benoit has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2018056491.CaseDesc: On March 10, 1994, at approximately 6:15pm, Gallus Huber was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Gallus was scheduled to attend a language class but did not show up.

Case reference: 2006024199.CaseDesc: Diane Cudmore was last seen on February 22, 1972, before she wandered away from her home. Diane was known to have mental health issues that may have played a part in her disappearance.

Case reference: 2006010199.CaseDesc: Donald Chorney was last seen departing the Keys Lake Campground near Grassy Narrows, Ontario, to go for a boat ride.  He has not been seen since and is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2014006013.CaseDesc: Bruce Bradley Clarke is a nomadic individual who has traveled extensively throughout Canada, the United States, Mexico, South America, and Europe. Due to his opposition towards government and preference for anonymity, Bruce adopted numerous aliases.  Despite his unconventional lifestyle, he maintained consistent communication with his family, regularly calling or writing letters. The last time Bruce was in contact with his family was in June 1974. At that time, he was residing in a trailer on the outskirts of Tucson, Arizona, and he was employed by a landscaping company.

Teeth: Full upper dentures and a partial dental plate on lower jaw

Case reference: 2013000027.CaseDesc: Nancy Joanne Forbes has not been seen or heard from since November 7, 2006. Nancy was last seen at a bus stop on her way to a job interview in the Burnside Industrial Park in Dartmouth, Nova Scotia.

Case reference: 2019042986.CaseDesc: On August 14, 1987, at approximately 8:15am, Anna Lippert was last seen at the Etobicoke General Hospital in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2006028099.CaseDesc: Diane Marie Bourne was last seen on March 6, 1976, at her residence in Ashton, Ontario. Extensive police investigation has failed to locate her.

Case reference: 2018053584.CaseDesc: On May 15, 1996, at approximately 1:30 p.m., Esther Adam was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Esther had made arrangements to meet with a friend on May 18, at 10:00 a.m., but did not attend.

Case reference: 2018063233.CaseDesc: On March 4, 1994, at approximately 10:00pm, Stanislawa ‘Mary’ Jurkiewicz last spoke with her family. It is believed that the following morning, Mary left her residence in the area of Fern Avenue and Roncesvalles Avenue in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014005508.CaseDesc: In October 2010, Maxime Jacques left Winnipeg, Manitoba by bus to visit family in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. On October 30, 2010, Mr. Jacques never arrived at his destination and his family reported him as missing.

Case reference: 2014002257.CaseDesc: James Clarke was last seen in Kemptville, Ontario on May 10, 1975. At the age of sixteen, James left his mother’s home, and his family have not heard from him since.

Case reference: 2012020055.CaseDesc:
The body of an Asian male was discovered by cleaning staff at the Northbrook Inn in Grand Rapids, Manitoba.  The individual had checked in at 15:30h after arriving on the bus from Winnipeg.  At 18:00h cleaning staff entered the room to find the occupant deceased in a chair.
It was learned that the subject checked into the hotel under the name "CHERON, Deoung".  A small black bag containing herbal medication was located in the room, which after translation from Korean revealed the prescription was issued to "PARK, Seng Dae"(variation of spelling PARK, Sang Dae).  It should be noted that the bus ticket-stub was located with the deceased identified "DUNG" as the individual who purchased the ticket.
Numerous checks were made with variety of agencies in an attempt to determine the man's identity.  It is believed he may be of Korean or Chinese decent.

Case reference: 2021038782.CaseDesc: On June 17, 2017, at approximately 7:50 p.m., John Shankland was last seen near the Brink of the American Falls in Niagara Falls, New York. During the time of his disappearance, John was despondent.

Case reference: 2014005235.CaseDesc: On April 8, 2009 at approximately 9:30 a.m., Anthony Ponikvar was observed in the area of Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance, Anthony was feeling despondent. To date his whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2024048307.CaseDesc: Margaret McCrae-Carreau was last seen at a medical appointment on May 24, 2016, when she was living in the Sandy Hill neighbourhood of Ottawa, Ontario.  It is out of character for her to be out of contact with her family. There have been no social media posts from her since November 2015. Margaret is legally blind and was on social assistance; her file was officially closed in May 2017, but has been suspended since August 2016 due to lack of contact.

Case reference: 2014004103.CaseDesc: Michelle Gurney was last seen in the downtown east side of Vancouver at the St. James Community Society building on December 11, 1998. She was reported missing ten days later. Ms. Gurney was engaged in a high risk lifestyle and had mental health issues.

Case reference: 2012020047.CaseDesc: Joseph Thomas Zerk was last seen on December 1, 2008 in Edmonton, Alberta. He was dealing with some medical issues and had experienced periods of homelessness.

Case reference: 2014003250.CaseDesc: On November 1, 1974, four people left the Whitedog Indian Reserve, Ontario in a 14' Lund boat and were heading for Pointe du Bois, Manitoba. Their intention was to go to Pointe du Bois to pick up supplies and then return to Whitedog. On November 5, 1974, these individuals were reported missing as they had never returned to Whitedog.  It is believed that the boat overturned and everyone drowned. Two bodies were recovered, and the cause of death was determined to be drowning. Searches were conducted by boat and by air but the bodies of Paul Scott and Richard Petawanahqueb were never recovered.  Paul and Richard are presumed dead due to drowning. No foul play is suspected.

Case reference: 2017055687.CaseDesc: On April 17, 2017, Ryan Mead was seen for the last time leaving his family residence in Brampton, Ontario to travel to British Columbia. Ryan purchased camping equipment in Medicine Hat, Alberta in May of 2017. Some of his possessions were recovered along the South Saskatchewan River in late May.

Case reference: 2006000199.CaseDesc: October 26, 1986, an unidentified man was found under the ramp to the Gardiner Expressway and Spadina Avenue behind 252 Queens Quay West, in Toronto, Ontario. He was well-nourished, and was found not wearing any clothing.

Hair: Grey, White, Short, Male pattern baldness, 4mm facial stubble
Mark: Left Elbow, Small mole on the side of his left elbow

Case reference: 2018063463.CaseDesc: During the last week of November in 1992, Slavko Orasnin was seen for the last time by his landlord in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2005001799.CaseDesc: On June 1, 1975, the body of an older adult female was located on the west bank of the Niagara River, in the town of Niagara-on-the-Lake. She is believed to be the same person who was witnessed jumping into the Horseshoe Falls on February 17, 1975. She is thought to be 40 plus years, short and heavy-set, with brown hair. She suffered from lung disease and had severe arthritis of her lumbar spine, which may have been painful. When witnessed going over the Falls, she was wearing a long overcoat, possibly grey, and carrying a green umbrella. There is no confirmation that the jumper and the deceased are the same person, however the general descriptions are in agreement. The condition of her remains suggest that she had been in the water for weeks to months.

Teeth: This female probably had a partial dental plate and still retained a gold crown on her right upper canine tooth.

Case reference: 2013000041.CaseDesc: David Luborsky was reported missing on the 4th of November 2010. David was last seen leaving the Parklane Residence which is situated at 1095 Merivale Road, in the City of Ottawa.

Right Side Of Neck, Clover leaf

Case reference: 2014003189.CaseDesc: On January 15, 1986, Michel Guertin was seen for the last time in Sorel-Tracy, Quebec. Michel has not been seen or not heard from him since.

Case reference: 2012020655.CaseDesc: On May 22, 2008, Wilson Grant Nokohoot was seen for the last time on the 1800 block of Smith Street, Regina, Saskatchewan. It is unusual for Wilson to not have regular contact with family and acquaintances.

Case reference: 2014004449.CaseDesc: Fred Johnsen was last seen on August 28, 1979, leaving his family home near Old Forest Hill Road and Eglinton Avenue West in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004819.CaseDesc: Reginald (Reggie) Andrew Flett was last seen walking in downtown Thompson, Manitoba shortly before he went missing on September 17th, 2006. Reggie had previously been seen near the Walmart and Extra Foods. He was reported missing by his family on September 19th, 2006.  Despite searches in Split Lake and Thompson and the distribution of posters, he was not located. Reggie's whereabouts remain unknown and the investigation is ongoing.

Case reference: 2014005302.CaseDesc: On November 11, 2005, in Toronto, Canada, Zaina Trujillo-Talib was abducted by her father, Chaudhry Talib and her paternal grandmother, Shama Talib.  Chaudhry and Shama immediately took six-year-old Zaina to their family home located in Lahore, Pakistan.  Since this time, Zaina's mother has not been allowed to have any contact with her daughter.

Case reference: 2014006315.CaseDesc: Julia Strobach was last seen in her residence on Braidwood Road in Courtenay, British Columbia on October 31st, 2013 in the early evening hours.  Unfortunately, after a lengthy and comprehensive investigation police have been unable to find any trace of Julia.  Police along with Julia’s friends and family are gravely concerned for Julia's wellbeing as she has been out of contact for a year now.  It is completely out of character for Julia to be out of contact with her friends and family for so long, especially with her 3 year old son.  Julia’s red bicycle with yellow seat was also missing. Police are appealing to anyone with information about Julia's movements and activities in the days and weeks leading up to October 31st, 2013, to get in touch with investigators immediately.

Hair: Brown, Red, Dyed, Long, Often dyed red
Backpack: Metal, Red, Yellow, Julia’s red bicycle with yellow seat was also missing.

Mark: Nose, Thin red mark below bridge of nose
Chest, Round birthmark located near ribcage area

Case reference: 2014030665.CaseDesc: On January 19, 1978, the partial remains of a female believed to be aged between 55-70 years of age, were found in the waters of the Salish Sea, southwest of Victoria, British Columbia. She had moderate arthritis and significant healed injuries to her left ankle and foot. It is believed she was deceased several months or even years before her remains were recovered

Case reference: 2014002519.CaseDesc: Denis Beauchamp was last seen on April 18, 1977 in Montreal, Quebec. Denis went to his sister's house after an argument with his boyfriend. Denis stayed there for a few days, and then left without giving any more news.

Case reference: 2014004031.CaseDesc: On April 30, 1974, Earland Christopher Feldseth was seen for the last time at a grocery store in Tofino, British Columbia. Case reference: 2025024076.CaseDesc: On May 2, 2025, Natanis Merasty travelled from Saskatchewan to Edmonton, Alberta, and stayed at the Continental Inn on Stony Plain Road with a group of individuals. She departed from the Continental Inn on May 5, 2025, in the early morning hours.  CCTV footage shows her at a nearby 7-Eleven at 02:55 a.m. Natanis has not been in contact with family since that time, which is highly unusual for her. Her disappearance is considered to be of a suspicious nature.

Shirt: Grey, Black, Grey with black long sleeves
Scar: Self-harm scars on the legs and arms
Tattoo: Possibility of a cross tattoo on either forearm
Left Hand, Rose and vine with initials "DJM"

He had also said that they would be gone for approximately 10 days, and would be back before their sons, Russell and Ryan Jack, started their school year in September.

Case reference: 2006015899.CaseDesc: Pamela Holopainen was last seen in the city of Timmins, Ontario in the early morning hours of December 14, 2003, following a house party.

In his possession were a "Hipstreet" brand MP3 player and headphones. The images shown are facial approximation portraits of this unidentified man created by the Sûreté du Québec.

Case reference: 2014003280.CaseDesc: On July 7, 1998, Peter Dekoning was reported missing after failing to return home from making his restaurant deliveries. He was last seen at Jackfish Lake near Two Hills where he was believed to have stayed for several days. His vehicle was located near the North Saskatchewan river with the keys missing. There was no sign of foul play. A search of land and water was unsuccessful.

Pants: Dark Blue, Black, pants were either dark blue or black
Scar: Jaw, long white scar down right side of chin

Case reference: 2024061875.CaseDesc: On November 17, 2024, the Beaumont RCMP received a report that Shawn Edward Robson-Harder had not been seen in Beaumont since September 19, 2024. He had a history of frequenting major cities and First Nations throughout Alberta.  However, had never gone this long without checking in with friends. Shawn's friends and family are concerned for his well-being.

Case reference: 2012020063.CaseDesc: On June 18, 1966, Kimberley Mclean was seen for the last time in Whiteshell Provincial Park in Rennie, Manitoba. That day, Kimberley and her mother had attended Camp Alloway for a staff picnic.  Upon their arrival, Kimberley changed into her bathing suit and went to the dock area. Five minutes later, Kimberley's mother went down to the dock with some cookies for her daughter, but was unable to find her.

Case reference: 2016067951.CaseDesc: On October 15, 2016, Eric Ratt was last seen canoeing approximately 70 km east of the MacArthur River to Sandy Lake (Points North area), Saskatchewan. He has cabins at Sandy Lake and was traveling alone up the Geike River with approximately three weeks of supplies. Eric was reported missing after failing to pick up supplies from a pre-arranged location.

Case reference: 2014030834.CaseDesc: On May 28, 1967 at approximately 9:00 a.m. John Pawloski, his common-law wife and a young boy (9 years old) were fishing in the area of Pointe du Bois, Manitoba. John's fishing rod started to slip into the water and he ran to reach at it. He fell into the fast moving water. His wife attempted to rescue him, but she too slipped on the rocks and fell into the water. The young boy ran to get help and when he looked back he could no longer see the couple.  The body of John's wife was found down the river shortly after the incident. Searches for John's body were done by air, land and water but the body was never found. He is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2020011788.CaseDesc: On May 22, 1982, Ian Shim was seen for the last time when he checked into the Gran Hotel in Pereira, Columbia. Ian, a resident of Toronto, Ontario, was on vacation in Colombia. Shortly after checking in, Ian had gone for a hike, but never returned to his room to collect his personal belongings.

Case reference: 2012020165.CaseDesc: The remains of this male were found in a forested area immediately north of the Port Coquitlam cemetery.
